passive.name: King of Knights
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **36/45/54/63/72%**. When using Ultimate, increases the wearer's ATK by **40/50/60/70/80%**, and if the wearer's Max Energy is greater than or equal to **300**, regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to **10%** of the wearer's Max Energy and once again increases the wearer's ATK by **40/50/60/70/80%**, lasting for **2** turns.

passive.name: At Will
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **18/21/24/27/30%** and Energy Regeneration Rate by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%**. When the wearer uses Ultimate, for every 1 Energy consumed, increases the Ultimate DMG dealt this time by **0.2/0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4%**, up to a max increase of **72/90/108/126/144%**. When the wearer enters combat or uses Ultimate, the wearer gains "King's Entertainment," lasting for **3** turn(s). While the wearer holds "King's Entertainment," increases all allies' CRIT DMG by **24/30/36/42/48%**. Effects of the same type cannot stack.

weapons.name: On the Fall of an Aeon

passive.name: Moth to Flames
passive.text: When the wearer attacks, increases their ATK by **8/10/12/14/16%** in this battle. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). After the wearer breaks an enemy's Weakness, increases DMG dealt by **12/15/18/21/24%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Dispossession
passive.text: The wearer's base SPD increases by **12/14/16/18/20**. When dealing DMG, ignores **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%** of the target's DEF. After the wearer uses Ultimate, gains "Blazing Sun," which is removed at the start of the turn. While holding "Blazing Sun," increases the wearer's DMG dealt by **60/78/96/114/132%**.

passive.name: Massacre
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. The Skill DMG and Ultimate DMG dealt by the wearer increase by **24/28/32/36/40%**.

passive.name: Spare No Effort
passive.text: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The wearer also deals an extra **20/25/30/35/40%** of DMG to enemies whose current HP percentage is equal to or higher than the wearer's current HP percentage.

substatLine: SPD (Until Desired Breakpoint) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK%
tracePriority: Knight of the Dragon (A2) > Blessing of the Lake (A4) > Crown of the Star (A6)

entries.name: Invisible Air: Barrier of the Wind King
entries.text: Deals Wind DMG equal to **100%** of Saber's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Release, the Golden Scepter
entries.text: Gains **2** point(s) of "Core Resonance" and deals Wind DMG to all enemies equal to **150%** of Saber's ATK. When this ability is used, if the number of enemy targets is 2 or 1, additionally deals Wind DMG to all enemies equal to **150%** or **220%** of Saber's ATK respectively.

entries.name: Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King
entries.text: Deals Wind DMG equal to **150%** of Saber's ATK to one designated enemy, and deals Wind DMG equal to **75%** of Saber's ATK to adjacent targets. If Saber currently holds "Core Resonance" and her Energy can be fully regenerated by consuming "Core Resonance" after this instance of Skill attack, then increases the multiplier for this instance of Skill. For every 1 point of "Core Resonance," increases the DMG multiplier for this instance of Skill by **14%**. And after the attack, consumes all "Core Resonance" to regenerate Energy for Saber. Otherwise, immediately gains **3** point(s) of "Core Resonance."

entries.name: Excalibur
entries.text: Deals Wind DMG equal to **280%** of Saber's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals **10** instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Wind DMG equal to **110%** of Saber's ATK dealt to one random enemy. After using Ultimate, the next Basic ATK switches to "Release, the Golden Scepter," and only "Release, the Golden Scepter" can be used.

entries.name: Dragon Reactor Core
entries.text: When entering combat, gains **1** "Core Resonance" point(s). When any ally target uses Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by Saber by **60%** for **2** turn(s) and gains **3** "Core Resonance" point(s). For every 1 "Core Resonance" point consumed, regenerates a fixed amount of **8** Energy for Saber.

entries.name: Behold, the King of Knights
entries.text: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, increases Saber's ATK by **35%** for **2** turn(s) and gains **2** "Core Resonance."

entries.name: Knight of the Dragon
entries.text: Increases Saber's CRIT Rate by **20%**. When entering combat or when using her Enhanced Basic ATK, gains the "Mana Burst" effect. Under this effect, if Saber has "Core Resonance" and her Energy can be fully regenerated by using her Skill and consuming "Core Resonance," then consumes "Mana Burst" to recover 1 Skill Point for allies, and causes Saber to immediately take action.

entries.name: Blessing of the Lake
entries.text: Saber can accumulate up to **120** overflow Energy. After using Ultimate, the overflow Energy is cleared and a corresponding amount of Energy is regenerated. When the battle starts, if Energy is below **60%**, it is regenerated to **60%**.

entries.name: Crown of the Star
entries.text: When using Skill, increases Saber's CRIT DMG by **50%** for **2** turns. During this battle, for every 1 point of "Core Resonance" gained, increases Saber's CRIT DMG by **4%**, stacking up to **8** time(s).

entries.name: The Lost White Walls
entries.text: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Saber by 60%. After Saber uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains 1 "Core Resonance."

entries.name: The Lost Oath of the Round Table
entries.text: For every 1 point of "Core Resonance" gained in this battle, Saber's DMG dealt ignores 1.0% of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to 15 time(s). When triggering the "Core Resonance" effect to boost Skill's multiplier, each point of "Core Resonance" additionally increases the DMG multiplier for the current instance of Skill by 7%.

entries.name: A Wish Across Fifteen Centuries
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: The Saga of Sixteen Winter Days
entries.text: Increases Saber's Wind RES PEN by 8%. After using Ultimate, increases Saber's Wind RES PEN by 4%. This effect stacks up to 3 time(s).

entries.name: The Dreamed Utopian Dawn
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: The Long Fated Night
entries.text: The Wind RES PEN of the Ultimate DMG dealt by Saber increases by 20%. The amount of overflow Energy that can be accumulated with the Trace "Blessing of the Lake" increases to 200. After using Ultimate for the first time upon entering combat, regenerates a fixed amount of 300 Energy for Saber. This effect can trigger 1 time after every 3 Ultimate use(s).

items.name: A Glass of the Besotted Era
